answer_prose: The average improvement over an earlier-year recorded best was 18.9 minutes. The final 12.195 km supplied 7.7 of those minutes: 38.0 seconds gained per km, versus 17.2 seconds per km in the opening 10 km.
detail_prose: This is a best within the recorded earlier-year history. Races absent from the export and other races in the same year prevent a lifetime-PB claim.
